changes.name: MeteorUpgrades
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")
local folder=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeStations")
if folder then folder:Destroy() end
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")

local defs={
 {key="MiningPower",title="MINING POWER",effect="+1 Power",base=20,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,-14),color=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,70)},
 {key="MiningSpeed",title="MINING SPEED",effect="Faster Mining",base=30,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,0),color=Color3.fromRGB(80,180,255)},
 {key="MiningLuck",title="LUCK",effect="Bonus Gems",base=40,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,14),color=Color3.fromRGB(190,100,255)}
}
local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeStations")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="UpgradeStations";folder.Parent=world

local function setupPlayer(p)
 for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
  if not p:FindFirstChild(d.key) then local v=Instance.new("IntValue");v.Name=d.key;v.Value=0;v.Parent=p end
 end
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
 local b=Instance.new("Part");b.Name=d.key.."Station";b.Size=Vector3.new(15,7,2);b.Position=d.pos;b.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,-90,0);b.Anchored=true
 b.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;b.Color=Color3.fromRGB(30,34,42);b.Parent=folder
 local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=d.color;light.Brightness=1.4;light.Range=14;light.Parent=b
 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front;gui.CanvasSize=Vector2.new(600,300);gui.Parent=b
 local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel");txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);txt.BackgroundTransparency=1;txt.TextColor3=d.color
 txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;txt.TextScaled=true;txt.TextWrapped=true;txt.Parent=gui
 local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");prompt.ActionText="BUY UPGRADE";prompt.ObjectText=d.title;prompt.HoldDuration=.15
 prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=b
 local function refreshFor(p)
  local lv=p:FindFirstChild(d.key);if not lv then return end
  local cost=d.base*(lv.Value+1)
  txt.Text=d.title.."\nLevel "..lv.Value.."  →  "..(lv.Value+1).."\n"..d.effect.."\n💎 "..cost
  prompt.ActionText="BUY - "..cost.." GEMS"
 end
 prompt.PromptShown:Connect(function(p) refreshFor(p) end)
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
  local lv=p:FindFirstChild(d.key);local gems=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Gems")
  if not lv or not gems then return end
  local cost=d.base*(lv.Value+1)
  if gems.Value>=cost then gems.Value-=cost;lv.Value+=1;refreshFor(p) end
 end)
end
print("Meteor upgrade stations loaded on left, facing inward")
